authority.authorized_now: source-only implementation, CPU synthetic tests, recursive source closure, source freeze, and independent science/custody review
authority.execution_requires: committed source manifest and freeze, independent review with zero unresolved findings, and separate machine authorization binding this preregistration, source commit, review, exact runtime inputs, interpreter, schedule, and absent output root
authority.pass_boundary: A valid update-1000 pass qualifies only this perception-plus-joint-JEPA mechanism for a separately preregistered downstream decision; it does not authorize checkpoint reading, navigation, G2, or any held-out access.

material_difference: Camera and multiresolution lines inferred ray or ordinal camera fields before BEV state; this candidate directly lifts RGB tokens into a rich BEV latent.

The Direct-BEV line let every learned BEV query attend globally over all image tokens; this candidate permits only K bounded samples around a fixed projective anchor and has no global-attention bypass.
The signed-boundary line compressed perception into two fields before dynamics; this candidate retains a 64-channel latent and uses a three-class semantic head only as grounding.

Updates 401-1000 jointly train the online RGB representation and action-conditioned predictor against a stop-gradient EMA next-RGB target, so this phase is a genuine JEPA rather than a predictor fitted later to frozen embeddings.

safe_v3_evidence.interpretation: The semantic objective and aggregate NLL kept improving while occupied recall collapsed and the free/occupied gap widened. The signed-boundary semantic-anchor family is closed; the next test changes the lift mechanism, not its weight or gate timing.

exact_runtime_inputs.role_rule: Preserve exact train and checkpoint-selection rows, ordering, labels, action vocabulary, current/next endpoints, mapped negatives, and role isolation; no render, rebuild, filter, resample, remap, new scene, held-out, or sealed role.

model.encoder: online trainable 112x112 RGB VisionEncoder, patch7, width192, depth6, heads6, initialized only from the exact N320 encoder state; no N320 head or optimizer state

geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.anchor: Each BEV-cell center has a fixed level-camera projective anchor derived only from frozen camera intrinsics/extrinsics and the registered BEV lattice; anchors are constant buffers, never per-frame measurements.
geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.invalid_anchor_policy: out-of-frustum cells receive learned null evidence, cannot sample any image token, and must remain semantically UNKNOWN
geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.offset_parameterization: 2*tanh(raw_offset) encoder-token cells independently in x and y
geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.refinement: two width64 local residual Conv2d blocks with kernel3 stride1 padding1
geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.sample_operator: bilinear sampling of the spatial RGB-token map only
geometry_anchored_deformable_lift.weight_operator: softmax over the four sampled values

model.initialization: N320 encoder-only migration plus deterministic fresh deformable-lift, null-evidence, semantic-head, predictor, and target construction in a registered draw order; initial target hard sync; no prior runtime state reuse.
model.predictor: A trainable nine-action embedding conditions a width64 local two-block 3x3 residual predictor on current online BEV latent and produces one next-latent candidate per action; no coordinate, goal, map, pose, attitude, label, future-image, or global-attention bypass.
model.semantic_head: Conv2d(64,3,kernel_size=1,bias=True) yielding UNKNOWN/FREE/OCCUPIED logits; labels train this head and representation but are never inference inputs
model.target: A requires_grad_false EMA copy of encoder, deformable lift, and local latent refinement is hard-synced once at update zero, updated after every online optimizer update with momentum 0.996 throughout warmup and joint phases, and supplies only stop-gradient current/next latent targets.

optimizer_and_gradient_controls.additional_required_norms: At every active phase, the trainable representation group norm is finite and nonzero; at every joint update the predictor norm is finite and nonzero; target gradients are absent.

optimizer.lifecycle: one instance constructed once at update zero with disjoint representation_semantic and predictor parameter groups; ordered membership is frozen before execution and the optimizer is never rebuilt
optimizer.name: AdamW

shared_gradient_contribution_gate.applied: every joint optimizer update 401-1000, aggregated over its four microbatches before clipping
shared_gradient_contribution_gate.dynamics_norm: unscaled pre-clip L2 norm of grad(P_latent_prediction+R_action+C_same_action_contrast) on those same shared parameters
shared_gradient_contribution_gate.failure: immediate terminal numerical/scientific failure with no retry; no dynamic loss reweighting or gradient rescaling is permitted
shared_gradient_contribution_gate.required: both norms finite and strictly positive, semantic_norm/dynamics_norm in [1/32,32], and dynamics_norm/semantic_norm in [1/32,32]
shared_gradient_contribution_gate.semantic_norm: unscaled pre-clip L2 norm of grad(S) on shared online encoder+lift+refinement parameters

optimizer_and_gradient_controls.warmup_predictor_membership_but_zero_wor: The predictor group exists from update zero, but updates 1-400 perform no predictor forward, objective, backward, state creation, or parameter update; the optimizer is never rebuilt at update 401.

semantic_term.A: 0.5*A_current+0.5*A_next, where each side is the equal-row mean of equal-present-final-class macro NLL over UNKNOWN/FREE/OCCUPIED from the online semantic head
semantic_term.fixed: no class weight, focal term, label smoothing, learned temperature, auxiliary head, signed-distance term, or annealing
semantic_term.labels: scheduled current and next raster_labels.u1 on the training role only

updates_1_through_400_perception_warmup.update_400_persistence_baseline: B400 is the finite strictly-positive checkpoint-selection mean smooth-L1(beta=1) between per-cell channel-LayerNorm stop-gradient EMA current and next latents when identity persistence predicts current as next; freeze its scalar and content hash before any joint update.

updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.C_same_action_contrast: two-way cross_entropy between the executed-action prediction energy to its correct next target and its exact fixed same-role same-scene mapped deranged next target, using the same detached energy scale, divided by log(2)
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.P_latent_prediction: executed-action E divided by frozen B400
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.R_action: cross_entropy of nine logits -E_action/detached_mean_action_energy_clamped_min_1e-6 against the executed action, divided by log(9)
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.genuine_JEPA_receipt: online representation and predictor both receive latent-prediction gradients; EMA target receives no gradient; semantic grounding remains active; predictor is not fitted after freezing the encoder
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.latent_energy: E(p,z)=mean smooth-L1(beta=1) between per-cell channel-LayerNorm predictor output p and stop-gradient per-cell channel-LayerNorm target z
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.online_current: current RGB encoded by the trainable online encoder and deformable lift
updates_401_through_1000_genuine_joint_J.target_next: next RGB encoded only by the stop-gradient EMA target branch for the JEPA target

scientific_question: Can a geometry-anchored local deformable RGB-to-BEV lift preserve balanced obstacle semantics through a short warmup and then support genuine jointly trained action-conditioned latent prediction without representation collapse or gradient starvation?

review_must_freeze: all architecture constants and parameter inventories

stop_and_closure.first_failed_applicable_conjunct: stop immediately, write complete failure receipts, mark every checkpoint unqualified, and close this attempt with no retry or resume
stop_and_closure.future_work_after_failure: requires a materially different preregistered mechanism; no V1 repair, retry, continuation, or same-root run
stop_and_closure.update_1000_pass: mechanism-only evidence; checkpoint remains write-only and unqualified for downstream use until a separate terminal audit and authority document
